note: LB.8b (legacy-only). One repo, seven manifest-rooted projects plus root-level shared code. tRPC sides (RPC_PROCEDURE in services/users and services/legacy, RPC_CALL in apps/web and apps/admin) and event sides carry LB.4a's ` @<project path>` owner suffix. tRPC is a network channel, so every call pairs every same-path procedure (2 x 2 RPC_CALLS). An IN-PROCESS event (services/orders and services/billing each on its own EventEmitter) pairs only inside one project or with an unowned side: lib/bus.ts sits under the root manifest only, so its handler pairs with both services' emitters (pinned exactly by engine/tests/channel_owner_rpc_event.rs, since a recall substring cannot tell it from the owned handlers), while orders never flows into billing's handler. A TRANSPORT event (a NestJS microservices @EventPattern handler in services/notify, fed by a ClientProxy.emit in services/orders) pairs across projects like a queue. HEAD (ee4a84a, installed wheel): one RPC_PROCEDURE rpc:user.list, one RPC_CALL rpc_call:user.list, one RPC_CALLS; one EVENT_EMITTER event_emit:orderPlaced (both services' files), one EVENT_HANDLER event_handle:orderPlaced (three files), one EVENT_FLOWS per event name; `glia arch` 2 links, 2 unlocated.
